page_title: CRY 2-2 EVE | Crystal Palace v Everton 10/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Thomas Bramall is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+6' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+6' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
90+4' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall will be replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Everton).

90+3' Golden chance! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
90+2' Michael Keane (Everton) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the left side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
90+2' Everton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+1' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Dean Henderson makes a great save to stop his effort. Good work from Everton as they win a corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) accepts a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot towards the goal, but he only hits the left post! What an unlucky moment for him. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
88' Thierno Barry (Everton) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
86' Neat passing move from Crystal Palace in order to create new attacking opportunities.
84' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
83' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
80' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Brennan Johnson will be replaced by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace).
80' That's the end of the game for Merlin Rohl, who is replaced by Tyrique George (Everton).

80' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Jordan Pickford didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
77' 2 - 2 Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) has a great chance inside the box and slams the ball into the roof of the net.
76' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
74' Everton are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Beto leaves the pitch and Thierno Barry (Everton) comes on.
69' Jaydee Canvot (Crystal Palace) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
69' Crystal Palace win a corner.
66' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

66' Jordan Pickford makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) after a cross from the side. The ball goes out of play. Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
65' The game has come to an end for Jorgen Strand Larsen. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace).
63' Crystal Palace control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

60' A short pass finds Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.

57' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would probably have ended up in the bottom left corner, but Jordan Pickford pulls off a decent save to thwart him.
56' Merlin Rohl (Everton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Thomas Bramall blows for a foul. Crystal Palace have a free kick.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Everton comes to nothing.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Everton.

53' James Garner (Everton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Dean Henderson to dive and make a save. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.

52' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Everton are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

51' A rebound sits up nicely for Jaydee Canvot (Crystal Palace) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, slides well wide of the right post and out for a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
50' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Bramall saw the whole situation.

47' 1 - 2 A great individual effort by Beto (Everton)! Showcasing his skills, he weaves his way through the defence and produces a low shot from inside the box which goes into the bottom right corner. A quite a remarkable goal!
46' Referee Thomas Bramall blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) for his blatant foul.
45' Everton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
44' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is first to the rebound and sends a header goalwards but it's blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
44' Now Everton have a corner.
43' Everton fail to score from a corner as Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) leaps to collect the ball. It will be a corner kick for Everton.

42' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Jordan Pickford pulls off an easy save.

39' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Crystal Palace, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Thomas Bramall has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton). A free kick is awarded to Crystal Palace.
37' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
36' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
34' 1 - 1 Goal! Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
34' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

33' James Tarkowski (Everton) makes a good late run into the box and times his jump perfectly to get on the end of the corner kick, but his close-range header is brilliant blocked to deny him a certain goal.
32' The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
31' The free kick from long range, taken by Crystal Palace, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

30' James Garner (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Thomas Bramall had an easy-decision to make. Crystal Palace have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.

28' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.

27' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Crystal Palace are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
25' A cross from Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
22' Great teamplay by Crystal Palace as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
19' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
17' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!

17' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Jordan Pickford pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going low into the middle of the target.
17' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
16' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Crystal Palace are going to take it.
13' James Garner (Everton) brings an opponent down and Thomas Bramall interrupts the game.
11' None of the Crystal Palace players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
10' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) gets his head on the corner, but he sees his header blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Crystal Palace.
10' Crystal Palace force their opponents to concede a corner.
9' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Crystal Palace will take a corner kick.

7' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
6' 0 - 1 James Tarkowski (Everton) scores from the corner kick. The ball slipped through the box to James Tarkowski (Everton) and he slotted it past the goalkeeper.
5' The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
5' The resulting set piece from Everton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
3' Beto (Everton) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
1' The first half has just begun.
Everton will kick the game off.
Thomas Bramall was nominated as the referee for this game.
